extracted.intended_audience: People participating in or preparing for National Novel Writing Month (NaNoWriMo) — aspiring novelists seeking motivation and community during the November writing challenge.
extracted.subtask_description: A collection/page describing NaNoWriMo 'pep talks' — short inspirational letters from well-known authors delivered to participants during the November novel-writing challenge to motivate and sustain daily writing. Includes an archive of past pep talks and a roster of contributing authors by year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of Pep Talks
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep talks are inspirational letters written by well-known authors during NaNoWriMo just for you. They’ll be delivered to your NaNoMail inbox throughout NaNoWriMo season, ready to inspire you, motivate you, and keep you writing all month long.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended function is explicit: inspiration, motivation, and sustaining writing momentum during the month. The page frames pep talks as short, targeted encouragement rather than craft instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorship / Contributor credibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep talks are written by well-known authors (examples given: Andy Weir, Justina Ireland, Francesca Lia Block, Min Jin Lee; archive veterans include N. K. Jemisin, Rainbow Rowell, John Green, Neil Gaiman, Roxane Gay, Lois Lowry, Jason Reynolds, Dean Koontz, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The presence of notable, published authors is presented as a quality signal for the pep talks. The page lists many contributors by year to demonstrate breadth and credibility of voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivery format and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: They’ll be delivered to your NaNoMail inbox throughout NaNoWriMo season.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delivery is via NaNoMail and distributed 'throughout NaNoWriMo season' (i.e., during the November 1–30 challenge), implying episodic/periodic encouragement aligned with the event calendar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive and accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep Talk Archive — the site maintains an archive of past pep talks with author/year listing and links (e.g., 'Kevin Kwan 2017 Pep Talk', 'Roxane Gay 2017 Pep Talk', etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Archive lets participants access past pep talks by author and year; the page organizes talks chronologically and by contributor, making it a resource for retrospective inspiration or examples of tone/content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event scope / context
rubrics_metrics.description: National Novel Writing Month runs November 1-30 and is positioned as a time-bound challenge ('November 1-30 • The world needs your novel.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pep talks are contextualized within this fixed-time writing challenge; their content and timing are tailored to support the specific demands of producing a novel-length draft in one month.
